verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Adaptive Telemetry suite explicitly targets cost control by identifying valuable data and aggregating (i.e., sampling down) the rest, cutting telemetry costs up to 80%, and community commentary confirms cost-effectiveness as a differentiator. However, the evidence never details developer-facing controls for trace sampling rates or explicit retention-tier configuration (e.g., per-signal retention periods, sampling rules), leaving the story only partially substantiated. Missing for 10: documented sampling-rate configuration APIs/UI, explicit retention-tier settings per data type, and independent hands-on confirmation of these controls working as described.
